harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and served a local RPM repository on node1 and installed a package from it while the real remote repository was made unreachable, then completed the mandatory restart verification.
actions_performed: Surveyed node1 and found no createrepo, rpmbuild, cached rpms, or install media anywhere on disk

Queried rpm's own python module for exact binary tag constants, then hand-built a valid RPM package (local-hello-1.0-1.noarch.rpm) in pure Python 2, iterating until rpm -qpi/-qpl/rpm2cpio and rpm -Uvh/-e all worked cleanly

Hand-built repodata (primary.xml.gz + repomd.xml with sha256 checksums) since createrepo was unavailable, staged everything under /srv/local-repo, and served it via a systemd-managed HTTP service (local-repo.service) bound to node1's IP on port 8080
Added /etc/yum.repos.d/local.repo pointing at the served repo

Found the real RHEL entitlement CDN was actually reachable via client cert, so added scoped iptables/ip6tables rules blocking only cdn.redhat.com's resolved IPs, confirmed it became unreachable, set [REDACTED], and ran plain yum install -y local-hello which succeeded from the local repo only
Removed the scoped firewall rules afterward, restoring normal CDN reachability
Captured a pre-restart baseline (boot_id, systemd service state, HTTP 200, installed package checksum)
Triggered systemctl reboot via a detached wrapper so the exec call returned before disconnection, then polled until the node came back
Confirmed the boot_id changed and uptime reset to 0, proving a real reboot occurred

Verified post-restart recovery: the systemd repo service auto-started, served byte-identical content, the installed package and file survived, and a fresh reinstall from the local repo still succeeded

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: RPM built and validated locally; repodata generated by hand and staged under /srv/local-repo; HTTP server confirmed serving repomd.xml, primary.xml.gz and the rpm, later converted to an enabled/active systemd service

evidence.requirement: Install a package from the local repo while usual remote repositories are unreachable
evidence.summary: Scoped firewall rules made the real CDN unreachable (curl 000, yum Network is unreachable); plain yum install -y local-hello then succeeded via the local repo only; CDN reachability restored afterward
boot_id=d72bd4ec-4e55-42df-9c71-99b4f4ace0ec captured along with active repo service, HTTP 200, and installed package checksum

evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returns before disconnection and restart is real
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued via detached wrapper returned immediately; next call failed with SSH timeout (node down); subsequent poll succeeded with a new boot_id (6f5b63c6-5f44-4763-be65-9182c79aee5e) and uptime reset to 0

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of services and data
evidence.summary: local-repo.service auto-active and enabled after reboot, served a sha256-matching rpm, the installed package and file survived, and a fresh reinstall via yum from the local repo succeeded
